Captains Log: 11/11/24 brook was born in russia and is legally named brookyn
6995 2019-2022: When playing foosball, bystanders must shout “Focus (name), focus! Focus and score!” repeatedly, preferably close to the player to assist focusing.

6995 2022ish-2024: We ordered a 6ft length of aluminum box tube that we then couldn’t find. People would look suspiciously at anything large enough to hide a 6ft piece of aluminum. This led to asking inanimate objects and later tall people “are you a 6ft piece of aluminum?” The 6ft piece of aluminum was never found, likely due to the fact that it had never actually been ordered in the first place. Even after this discovery, the elusive 6ft piece of aluminum was nearly found many times, but its doppelgängers would always come up short

Before Discord, 6995 used a now-defunct management software called Samepage. This caused no end of headaches organizationally, but it’s one benefit was the ease with which students could create folders and documents inside the “just for chatting” channel. By the time we migrated away from the software, there was a folder labyrinth so deep and convoluted that you would nearly always find something new. We had quotes, secrets, rickrolls, dead ends, nicknames for team members, complaints, and all manner of entertainment. Somewhere in the annals of the internet, that website may still exist, and perhaps an unwitting traveler will once again venture into the maze of boredom and inside jokes that is the “just for chatting” folder structure.

In the playoffs of Beach Blitz 2022, 6995’s robot Clawdia made a terrible grinding sound during a match. The pit crew had to disassemble the drive base to find the culprit. A drive gear had been completely shredded smooth. While watching the next match, we in the stands got the call “CAD is needed in the pits!” A thousand lifetimes flashed before the eyes of our CAD lead as he imagined what could possibly have gone so very wrong. In the pit, he pulled up the drive base CAD using a hotspot so the pit crew could rebuild the robot. That hotspot disabled the field, delaying the next match long enough to allow Clawdia to return to the field and eventually win the event. Despite the victory, we still remember those dark days when CAD was needed in the pits.
